segments.t: The complete reference for korTTY — a modern, cross-platform JavaFX SSH client with tabbed terminals, SFTP tooling, a background job scheduler, snippet management, terminal-effect plugins, integrated local GGUF inference and OpenAI-compatible AI assistance. Every feature, setting and tool, explained in detail.
KTPH000Press F1 inside korTTY to open this guideKTPH001
Install korTTY, set your master password, and learn the main window.
SSH/Mosh connections, tabs, split-screen, tunnels, jump servers and SFTP.
Every setting across all configuration tabs, with types, defaults and where each value is stored.
The full menu tree and every keyboard shortcut.
Profiles, skills, the AI Manager, and the terminal AI agent's tools.
Install, import, route, and run private GGUF models with integrated llama.cpp.
Review files or folders, build a safe local HNSW index, and add cited context to AI profiles.
Release notes for the current and previous versions.

This guide is bundled inside korTTY (KTPH001Help → ManualKTPH002, shortcut KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004) and published online. It is available in KTPH005EnglishKTPH006 and KTPH007GermanKTPH008, and is kept in sync with the code automatically. The korTTY version this guide was built for is shown in the footer.
